PBRify models shipped in the APK as the assets pbrify-normal.ncnn.param/.bin, pbrify-height.ncnn.param/.bin,
pbrify-roughness.ncnn.param/.bin and pbrify-upscale.ncnn.param/.bin, ncnn graphs (fp16 weights) of PBRify's normal,
height and roughness networks and of its 4x upscaler, for the relief and gloss maps and the neural x2 textures the game
makes on the device from the player's own game files (src/libs/relief). No game texture, map or upscaled texture is
shipped.

Author:    Kim2091, PBRify_Remix (https://github.com/Kim2091/PBRify_Remix): the SPAN models 1x-PBRify_NormalV3,
           1x-PBRify_Height and 1x-PBRify_RoughnessV2, released under CC0-1.0 (PBRify-CC0-1.0.txt).
Training:  OpenModelDB (openmodeldb.info/models/1x-PBRify-RoughnessV2, read 2026-11-14) lists the training dataset
           as "ambientCG + UltraSharpV2" (ambientCG's materials are CC0; UltraSharpV2 is Kim2091's upscaling model and
           its data). No separate licence is stated for the training data; the models themselves are CC0-1.0.
Export:    ONNX re-exports of those models by fernandotonon, QtMeshEditor-models
           (https://huggingface.co/fernandotonon/QtMeshEditor-models), listed there as CC0-1.0. I/O 1x3xHxW float
           0..1, free size. The revision and the SHA-256 of each file: the pins pbrify-normal, pbrify-height and
           pbrify-roughness in engine/pins.json of github.com/maxyo/seawolves (checked when the build downloads them).
Modified:  by src/libs/relief/model/make_ncnn_models.py: converted by pnnx (ncnn's converter) into ncnn graphs with
           fp16 weights, pbrify-normal/height/roughness.ncnn.param and .bin; their SHA-256 are in the same pins
           (ncnn_param_sha256, ncnn_bin_sha256, checked at build time). The modified files stay CC0-1.0.
Use:       run with ncnn (BSD-3-Clause, ncnn-BSD-3-Clause.txt) on the player's device (GPU or CPU), in the game process.

Upscaler (pbrify-upscale.ncnn.param/.bin):
Author:    Kim2091, PBRify_Remix release (pin pbrify-upscale in engine/pins.json: its version, URL and SHA-256), its
           file Extras/Old_Models/4x-PBRify_UpscalerSPANV4.pth, a 4x SPAN network, released under CC0-1.0 (the
           release's LICENSE; PBRify-CC0-1.0.txt).
Training:  the release's EXTRA_INFO.md: textures from ambientCG and PolyHaven (both CC0), degraded and DXT1-compressed,
           trained with traiNNer-redux. OpenModelDB (openmodeldb.info/models/4x-PBRify-UpscalerSPANV4, read 2026-11-14)
           lists the dataset as "ambientCG + UltraSharpV2" and the licence as CC0-1.0 (UltraSharpV2 is Kim2091's own
           upscaling model and its data; no separate licence is stated for it). The model itself is CC0-1.0.
Modified:  by src/libs/relief/model/make_upscale_model.py: exported to ONNX (opset 17, I/O 1x3xHxW float 0..1 and
           1x3x4Hx4W) with spandrel, converted by pnnx into an ncnn graph with fp16 weights. Kept in the source tree
           (engine/src/libs/relief/model of github.com/maxyo/seawolves) and checked at build time against the
           SHA-256 of the pin pbrify-upscale. The modified files stay CC0-1.0.
Use:       the game upscales a texture 4x with it on the player's device and box-filters the result to 2x in linear
           light (fx/upscale.hpp); the 2x textures are a cache in the app's cache directory.
